tenderSchedule.title: Establishment and Operation of Migration Support Center (MSC) in Bengaluru
tenderSchedule.description: Selection of Service Providers for the Establishment and Operation of Migration Support Center (MSC) in Bengaluru under the DDU-GKY Programme
tenderSchedule.deptName: Karnataka State Rural Livelihood Promotion Society

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Office of the Additional Mission Director Mysugar Building JC Rd Kumbaragundi, Kalasipalya

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions of the tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall have minimum of 3 years of experience in implementing programmes or projects in the following areas skill development livelihood promotion, Migration support services, post-placement support services

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work order and completion certificate
Others -- Technical presentation before the Evaluation Committee

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The agency should have an average annual turnover of at least Rs.60 lakhs during last 3 financial years i.e., in 2023-24, 2024-2025 and 2025-26.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall be a legally registered entity under the applicable laws of India and shall have been in existence for at least five (5) years
